items.title: European stocks close mostly lower as yields rise
items.summary: As London/European traders head for the exits, the major European stock indices are closing mostly lower. France's CAC 40 and Spain's Ibex led the declines, while Italy's FTSE MIB managed to finish virtually unchanged.
items.summaryZh: 随着伦敦/欧洲交易商纷纷退出，欧洲主要股票指数的收盘价大多较低。法国的CAC 40和西班牙的IBEX领跌，而意大利的富时MIB几乎没有变化。
items.summaryEn: As London/European traders head for the exits, the major European stock indices are closing mostly lower. France's CAC 40 and Spain's Ibex led the declines, while Italy's FTSE MIB managed to finish virtually unchanged.

items.title: Yen edges higher as traders push back Fed rate hike bets, shrug off soft GDP
items.summary: The yen's modest advance despite a clear GDP miss underscores how currency direction is currently being driven more by shifting Fed expectations than by domestic Japanese data, with fed funds futures now implying a two-thirds chance the Fed holds rates next month.
items.impactZh: 央行政策预期变化可能提升主要货币对波动，杠杆仓位的保证金与回撤压力上升。
items.impactEn: Shifts in central-bank expectations may increase major-pair volatility and raise margin/drawdown pressure on leveraged positions.
items.summaryZh: 尽管GDP明显下滑，但日元仍小幅上涨，这凸显出当前货币走向更多地受到美联储预期转变的推动，而不是日本国内数据的推动，联邦基金期货现在意味着美联储下个月维持利率的机会有三分之二。
items.summaryEn: The yen's modest advance despite a clear GDP miss underscores how currency direction is currently being driven more by shifting Fed expectations than by domestic Japanese data, with fed funds futures now implying a two-thirds chance the Fed holds rates next month.
